design.question_owner: docs/PREDICTION_REGISTER.md PRED-2026-011 (H3 successor: cross-site class preservation, clean withholding, disclosed mappability screen)
design.registered_prediction: Signs assigned to the INITIAL class in training on CISI Mohenjo-daro inscriptions ONLY, after the disclosed mappability screen, will appear preferentially in initial position in Harappa-specific Yajnadevam data as well.

criterion.pass_structure: with 2 trained signs the share can only be 0, 1/2, or 1; the 70% bar passes only at 2 of 2

order: training-pool and screen re-verification (registered filter; 179 rows, all Mohenjo-daro, zero Yajnadevam; manifest hash; the verbatim classification reproducing the unscreened set {P000, P217, P324}; the registered screen reproducing {P217, P324} exactly, with P000's exclusion as a screen outcome)
crosswalk coverage (the unmappable cap, under the fixed best-match reading)
step0.failure_closure: CANNOT BE RUN AS WRITTEN, unscored, reported as a closure and never as a verdict; the withheld file's content is opened only after all checks pass

design.crosswalk_reading: the frozen Phase-396 build's fix_crosswalk reading: a trained sign's counterparts are the glyphs whose crosswalk row names it as best_parpola_match; top3_parpola alternatives never create a counterpart and set the conflict flag instead (DD-036-5, carrying DD-035-5)

mappability_screen.rule: an INITIAL sign is eligible only if at least one row in the frozen crosswalk names it as best_parpola_match; top3_parpola appearances never establish eligibility
mappability_screen.screening_input: the public crosswalk only (SHA-256 e44b8b55...); no Harappa inscription rows, sequences, occurrence counts, or start rates informed the design
mappability_screen.excluded: P000 - no best-match counterpart (top3_parpola appearances only, on Y0527, Y0740, Y0820, Y0892); excluded for the mapping reason only, not for any observed Harappa behaviour

design.draft_stage_coverage_expectation: under the fixed reading on the pinned crosswalk, read at this draft: P217 -> glyph Y0520 (confidence 1.0, confirmed, sole best-match row); P324 -> glyph Y0740 (confidence 0.9867, confirmed, sole best-match row) - step 0 check 0.4 is therefore expected to PASS and the scoring to run; the expectation is recorded for the freeze decision and the formal determination remains a step-0 act

unmappable.over_cap_closure: CANNOT BE RUN AS WRITTEN before the withheld file is opened

design.method: positional classification only (SA-free): for each trained sign, through the frozen crosswalk, its start rate at Harappa is the share of its Harappa occurrences in the withheld sequences in which it stands in initial position (the first sign of a sequence); a mappable trained sign with zero Harappa occurrences does not meet the bar and remains in the denominator (registered rule; DD-036-2); the per-sign table is published descriptively and carries no criterion
design.disclosure: the Yajnadevam Harappa pool was previously inspected in aggregate during the Spec 032 closure audit (970 Harappa inscriptions in the old combined training corpus, carrying 1,013 occurrences of 11 of PRED-2026-006's 12 trained signs); no Harappa start rate has ever been computed for P217 or P324; the cleanliness claimed is verified training-pool exclusion, not analyst blindness
